records.name: loop_rental_fulfillment_readiness
statements:
-- Checkout preflight is server-only and returns true only when the durable
-- payment ledger, entitlement table, and atomic fulfillment RPC are present.
create or replace function public.loop_rental_fulfillment_ready()
returns boolean
language sql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $function$
  select
    pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.loop_payment_events') is not null
    and pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.loop_user_tvod_entitlements') is not null
    and pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(
      'public.loop_fulfill_captured_rental(text,text,uuid,text,timestamptz,timestamptz)'
    ) is not null;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.loop_rental_fulfillment_ready() from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.loop_rental_fulfillment_ready() to service_role;

statements:
-- Dedicated private media storage for StreamVista customer projects.
-- Apply only to the isolated StreamVista testing project before Preview integration.
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
values (
  'streamvista-private',
  'streamvista-private',
  false,
  1073741824,
  array[
    'video/mp4','video/quicktime','video/x-matroska',
    'audio/mpeg','audio/wav','audio/x-wav','audio/mp4',
    'application/pdf','application/zip','application/x-subrip','text/vtt','text/plain'
  ]::text[]
)
on conflict (id) do nothing;

create table if not exists public.streamvista_project_assets (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id uuid not null references public.streamvista_projects(id) on delete cascade,
  order_id uuid not null references public.streamvista_service_orders(id) on delete cascade,
  owner_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  storage_path text not null unique,
  file_name text not null check (char_length(file_name) between 1 and 240),
  content_type text not null,
  byte_size bigint not null check (byte_size between 1 and 1073741824),
  asset_role text not null default 'source' check (asset_role in ('source','output')),
  upload_status text not null default 'pending' check (upload_status in ('pending','available','failed','deleted')),
  qc_status text not null default 'not_applicable' check (qc_status in ('not_applicable','pending','approved','rejected')),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists streamvista_assets_owner_project_idx
  on public.streamvista_project_assets (owner_user_id, project_id, created_at desc);

alter table public.streamvista_project_assets enable row level security;
revoke all on public.streamvista_project_assets from anon, authenticated;
grant all on public.streamvista_project_assets to service_role;

records.name: buyer_acquisition_mandate_legal_scope_20261111
statements:
create table if not exists bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  buyer_organization_id uuid not null references public.bridge_organizations(id) on delete restrict,
  platform_code text not null,
  platform_account_id text not null,
  platform_channel_id text,
  status text not null default 'pending_review'
    check (status in ('draft','pending_review','approved','rejected','suspended','revoked','expired')),
  territory_codes text[] not null default '{}',
  language_codes text[] not null default '{}',
  media_rights text[] not null default '{}',
  exploitation_models text[] not null default '{}',
  exclusivity text not null default 'non_exclusive'
    check (exclusivity in ('exclusive','non_exclusive')),
  sublicensing_allowed boolean not null default false,
  onward_delegation_allowed boolean not null default false,
  effective_from timestamptz,
  effective_until timestamptz,
  agreement_reference text,
  created_by text not null,
  reviewed_by text,
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  review_notes text,
  revoked_by text,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint buyer_acquisition_mandates_term_check
    check (effective_until is null or effective_from is null or effective_until > effective_from),
  constraint buyer_acquisition_mandates_approval_check
    check (status <> 'approved' or (reviewed_by is not null and reviewed_at is not null and effective_from is not null and effective_until is not null)),
  constraint buyer_acquisition_mandates_platform_nonempty
    check (length(btrim(platform_code)) > 0 and length(btrim(platform_account_id)) > 0)
);

create index if not exists buyer_acquisition_mandates_org_status_idx
  on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates (buyer_organization_id, status);
create index if not exists buyer_acquisition_mandates_platform_idx
  on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates (platform_code, platform_account_id, platform_channel_id);

create table if not exists bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  mandate_id uuid not null references bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates(id) on delete restrict,
  evidence_kind text not null
    check (evidence_kind in ('signed_agreement','board_authorization','power_of_attorney','channel_ownership','territory_schedule','rights_schedule','other')),
  storage_object_path text not null,
  sha256_hex text,
  uploaded_by text not null,
  uploaded_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  review_status text not null default 'pending'
    check (review_status in ('pending','accepted','rejected')),
  reviewed_by text,
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  review_notes text,
  constraint buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence_sha_check
    check (sha256_hex is null or sha256_hex ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$'),
  constraint buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence_review_check
    check ((review_status = 'pending' and reviewed_by is null and reviewed_at is null)
        or (review_status <> 'pending' and reviewed_by is not null and reviewed_at is not null))
);

create index if not exists buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence_mandate_idx
  on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence (mandate_id, uploaded_at desc);

alter table bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates enable row level security;
alter table bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence enable row level security;

drop policy if exists deny_browser_access on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates;
create policy deny_browser_access on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates
  for all to anon, authenticated using (false) with check (false);
drop policy if exists deny_browser_access on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence;
create policy deny_browser_access on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence
  for all to anon, authenticated using (false) with check (false);

revoke all on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates from anon, authenticated;
revoke all on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence from anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update, delete on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates to service_role;
grant select, insert, update, delete on bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence to service_role;

comment on table bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandates is
  'Server-only legal acquisition mandate for verified platform buyers; distinct from story-concept mandates, buyer interest, and title access.';
comment on table bridge_private.buyer_acquisition_mandate_evidence is
  'Server-only metadata for legal evidence supporting buyer acquisition mandates; stores object references and hashes, not document contents.';

statements:
-- DIT ingest evidence workflow. Additive: does not alter title, asset, payment or rights rows.
-- Media copying is performed by the approved storage workflow; this schema records manifests and verification evidence.
alter table bridge_organization_memberships
  drop constraint if exists bridge_organization_memberships_membership_role_check;
alter table bridge_organization_memberships
  add constraint bridge_organization_memberships_membership_role_check
  check (membership_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'member', 'producer', 'dit'));

create table if not exists bridge_dit_ingest_sessions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  title_id text not null references bridge_titles(id) on delete cascade,
  organization_id uuid not null references bridge_organizations(id) on delete restrict,
  created_by text not null references bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  camera_unit text not null check (camera_unit in ('A', 'B', 'C')),
  camera_label text not null check (length(trim(camera_label)) > 0),
  card_label text not null check (length(trim(card_label)) > 0),
  shoot_date date not null,
  source_volume text not null,
  source_root text not null,
  source_manifest_sha256 char(64) not null check (source_manifest_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  source_file_count integer not null check (source_file_count > 0),
  source_total_bytes bigint not null check (source_total_bytes >= 0),
  status text not null default 'SOURCE_VERIFIED'
    check (status in ('SOURCE_VERIFIED', 'READY_FOR_SIGNOFF', 'SIGNED_OFF')),
  signoff_note text,
  signed_off_by text references bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  signed_off_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check ((status = 'SIGNED_OFF') = (signed_off_at is not null and signed_off_by is not null))
);

create index if not exists bridge_dit_ingest_sessions_org_created_idx
  on bridge_dit_ingest_sessions (organization_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists bridge_dit_ingest_sessions_title_idx
  on bridge_dit_ingest_sessions (title_id, created_at desc);

create table if not exists bridge_dit_ingest_files (
  session_id uuid not null references bridge_dit_ingest_sessions(id) on delete cascade,
  relative_path text not null check (length(relative_path) > 0),
  byte_size bigint not null check (byte_size >= 0),
  sha256 char(64) not null check (sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (session_id, relative_path)
);

create table if not exists bridge_dit_copy_verifications (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id uuid not null references bridge_dit_ingest_sessions(id) on delete cascade,
  copy_type text not null check (copy_type in ('PRIMARY', 'RECOVERY')),
  copy_root text not null,
  manifest_sha256 char(64) not null check (manifest_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  file_count integer not null check (file_count > 0),
  total_bytes bigint not null check (total_bytes >= 0),
  verified boolean not null default false,
  created_by text not null references bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (session_id, copy_type)
);

create index if not exists bridge_dit_copy_verifications_session_idx
  on bridge_dit_copy_verifications (session_id, copy_type);

alter table bridge_dit_ingest_sessions enable row level security;
alter table bridge_dit_ingest_files enable row level security;
alter table bridge_dit_copy_verifications enable row level security;
revoke all privileges on table bridge_dit_ingest_sessions from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all privileges on table bridge_dit_ingest_files from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all privileges on table bridge_dit_copy_verifications from public, anon, authenticated;

20261115220000_bridge_production_documents
statements:
-- Extend the Production asset register to represent legal/document assets
-- without misclassifying them as video or artwork.
--
-- The deployed register predates tracked migrations. This migration establishes
-- its schema for clean Supabase environments and safely extends the existing
-- production table. Existing owner-only identity binding is preserved.

create table if not exists public.bridge_production_assets (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  title_id text not null
    references public.bridge_titles(id) on update restrict on delete restrict,
  category text not null,
  file_name text not null,
  file_path text not null,
  file_size bigint not null,
  content_type text,
  tags jsonb default '{}'::jsonb,
  uploaded_by uuid default auth.uid(),
  created_at timestamptz not null default timezone('utc'::text, now()),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default timezone('utc'::text, now()),
  constraint bridge_production_assets_category_check
    check (category in ('raw_video', 'pilot_audio', 'stills', 'ad_reports', 'ad_logs', 'documents'))
);

alter table public.bridge_production_assets
  drop constraint if exists bridge_production_assets_category_check;

alter table public.bridge_production_assets
  add constraint bridge_production_assets_category_check
  check (category in ('raw_video', 'pilot_audio', 'stills', 'ad_reports', 'ad_logs', 'documents'));

create index if not exists bridge_production_assets_title_id_idx
  on public.bridge_production_assets(title_id);

alter table public.bridge_production_assets enable row level security;

-- Authenticated users cannot SELECT the title and identity-link tables directly.
-- Keep the ownership test inside a narrow security-definer helper.
create or replace function public.bridge_is_title_owner(p_title_id text)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $bridge_owner$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.bridge_titles t
    join public.bridge_loop_identity_links l
      on l.bridge_user_id = t.owner_user_id
    where t.id = p_title_id
      and l.auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())
  );
$bridge_owner$;

revoke all on function public.bridge_is_title_owner(text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.bridge_is_title_owner(text) to authenticated;

drop policy if exists bridge_production_assets_owner_select
  on public.bridge_production_assets;
create policy bridge_production_assets_owner_select
  on public.bridge_production_assets
  for select to authenticated
  using (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id));

drop policy if exists bridge_production_assets_owner_insert
  on public.bridge_production_assets;
create policy bridge_production_assets_owner_insert
  on public.bridge_production_assets
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id));

drop policy if exists bridge_production_assets_owner_update
  on public.bridge_production_assets;
create policy bridge_production_assets_owner_update
  on public.bridge_production_assets
  for update to authenticated
  using (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id))
  with check (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id));

drop policy if exists bridge_production_assets_owner_delete
  on public.bridge_production_assets;
create policy bridge_production_assets_owner_delete
  on public.bridge_production_assets
  for delete to authenticated
  using (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id));

revoke all on table public.bridge_production_assets from public, anon;
grant select, insert, update, delete
  on table public.bridge_production_assets to authenticated;
grant all on table public.bridge_production_assets to service_role;

records.name: 20261115221000_bridge_production_owner_rls_helper
statements:
-- Use a narrow security-definer helper for Production asset ownership.
-- Authenticated clients do not have direct SELECT privileges on bridge_titles
-- or bridge_loop_identity_links, so policy subqueries must not run as invoker.

create or replace function public.bridge_is_title_owner(p_title_id text)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.bridge_titles t
    join public.bridge_loop_identity_links l
      on l.bridge_user_id = t.owner_user_id
    where t.id = p_title_id
      and l.auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())
  );
$$;

revoke all on function public.bridge_is_title_owner(text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.bridge_is_title_owner(text) to authenticated;

drop policy if exists bridge_production_assets_owner_select
  on public.bridge_production_assets;
create policy bridge_production_assets_owner_select
  on public.bridge_production_assets
  for select to authenticated
  using (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id));

drop policy if exists bridge_production_assets_owner_insert
  on public.bridge_production_assets;
create policy bridge_production_assets_owner_insert
  on public.bridge_production_assets
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id));

drop policy if exists bridge_production_assets_owner_update
  on public.bridge_production_assets;
create policy bridge_production_assets_owner_update
  on public.bridge_production_assets
  for update to authenticated
  using (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id))
  with check (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id));

drop policy if exists bridge_production_assets_owner_delete
  on public.bridge_production_assets;
create policy bridge_production_assets_owner_delete
  on public.bridge_production_assets
  for delete to authenticated
  using (public.bridge_is_title_owner(title_id));
